questions.prompt: Tell a partner about a familiar trip or experience and make clear whether you mean one occasion or prior experience.
questions.context:
You have visited Beijing before; this is an experience claim, with no date supplied. Your partner went to Beijing yesterday; that is a particular event. Tell the partner about your own prior experience and distinguish it from their dated trip.
Familiar meanings available: travel; go on a trip; Beijing; previously; once.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn
